title: Fix Admin link visibility in header navigation

requirements.text: Debug and fix the Header component to ensure the Admin navigation link is visible and clickable in the header navigation menu

quotes: i cant see the admin link

acceptanceCriteria: Admin link is visible in the header navigation menu alongside the Products link
Admin link navigates to /admin route when clicked
Admin link styling is consistent with other navigation links in the header

requirements.text: Verify that the Link component for Admin in Header.tsx has correct routing configuration and is not conditionally hidden
acceptanceCriteria: Admin Link component exists in the Header component JSX
Admin Link has correct 'to' prop pointing to /admin route
No conditional rendering logic is hiding the Admin link from users

constraints: Do not modify the authentication flow for the admin dashboard
Keep the Admin link in the same navigation section as the Products link
nonGoals: Modifying the admin dashboard layout or functionality
Adding additional navigation links beyond fixing the Admin link
